```{r}
#| label: setup
source(file.path("report", "_setup.R"))
```

Suggest additions or corrections through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/CathalD/Carbon_Data_SOD/issues). Please include:

- the original source DOI or download, and the release or version;
- the licence;
- the carbon quantity and units, depth or pool, and reference period;
- the geographic scope, native raster grid or field support;
- the Earth Engine asset ID, where one exists.

For corrections, preserve original IDs and observations, and add a new version rather than silently overwriting field data. Discovery leads are welcome if their unresolved status is clear. Do not commit credentials or signed download URLs.
